summary: Malformed inline tables can exit parsing without a closing brace, leaving their span unset and causing a downstream 'all items have spans' panic. The fix tracks the latest event span and supplies a fallback outer span. The existing compliance test, updated by this fix, parses "={[]\r]." and expects a missing-key error instead of a panic. Reversing only the fallback restores the missing-span behavior while preserving the test. No tests were run.
